messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Inputs on same line?
parts:
Maybe something like this:

tags$table(
  border="0",
  cellpadding="0",
  cellspacing="6",
  tags$tr(
    tags$td(selectInput(...)),
    tags$td(selectInput(...)),
  )
)
